lead_raw_text:
The tetragonal compound Pr3Sb12 (space group I4_1/a, No. 143) has 15 atoms in the unit cell distributed over four independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows Pr centers with 11 neighbors (4 Pr, 7 Sb) and Sb centers in two distinct environments: one with 9 neighbors (5 Pr, 4 Sb) and another with 10 neighbors (7 Pr, 3 Sb). These coordination polyhedra connect into a single three-dimensional component spanning all 15 sites. Validated polyhedron contacts include corner, edge, and face sharing between 9-vertex and 10-vertex Sb polyhedra, as well as corner sharing between 11-vertex Pr and 9-vertex Sb polyhedra.
